acceptanceCriteria: corvint-tasks records a policy change through an OWNER or OPERATOR mutation with its own receipt, or the owner records a decision naming another route for the release-checklist gate.
The corvint store's release-checklist gate runs `script/release-checklist --pre-promotion` (or the decided replacement) and `corvint-tasks receipt audit` stays OK afterwards.
`corvint-tasks release readiness` on a candidate with every other gate attested reports gate:release-checklist from a real attestation, not as structurally missing.
body: Filed 2026-09-23. PR #117 (V1-0189) changed the release-checklist gate argv in .taskman/policy.json to `script/release-checklist --pre-promotion`. corvint-tasks treats that file as a projection of the journal, and its transaction model writes intent/policy.json only in the INIT operation (corvint-tasks internal/transaction/model.go), so the edit could not be adopted: every store read and mutation refused with INTENT_DIVERGED on intent/policy.json until the projection was restored to the journal bytes (sha256 501ae5be...). The corvint-tasks SPEC says policy changes are OWNER/OPERATOR mutations, but no such verb is implemented. Until one exists, the release-checklist gate still runs plain `script/release-checklist`, which cannot exit 0 at any commit (V1-0189 BUILD-LOG entry), so gate:release-checklist can never be attested and every release candidate stays BLOCKED on it. Needs an owner decision on the route: a policy mutation in corvint-tasks (separate repository), or a recorded decision that changes how this gate is attested.

completion.reason: Criterion 1: corvint-tasks 800682d adds the journaled OWNER/OPERATOR `policy update` verb. Criterion 2: the Corvint store policy was updated to policyVersion 2 with release-checklist argv ["script/release-checklist","--pre-promotion"] (receipt 000000000421, committed in PR #146 d841b10), and receipt audit stayed OK/AGREES/CONSISTENT. Criterion 3 NOT_OBSERVED: no v0-8 candidate exists because v0-5..v0-7 were never promoted (V1-0235), so readiness on a candidate with a real release-checklist attestation could not be run. Follow-up V1-0232 covers checking attestations against the policy argv. Completed at the owner's instruction on 2026-09-24.

title: The release-checklist policy gate cannot run --pre-promotion because corvint-tasks writes policy only at init
